verdict.rationale: All FR-01..FR-14 forensic and architectural defects repaired and verified by 28 adversarial tests (A01-A28) and 28 acceptance gates (R01-R28). P10 remains IN_PROGRESS because 118 built-in definitions and 173 discoverable App Intents remain in the eligible backlog.

FR-01.title: BROKEN immutable release tuple
FR-01.remediation: Established strictly acyclic release tuple: C_IMPLEMENT -> C_PROVENANCE -> D_DOCS -> C_RELEASE, repairing corrupted compiler SHA and stale docs reference

FR-02.title: INVALID acceptance proofs
FR-02.remediation: Replaced mock assertions and weak string checks with end-to-end production path tests and deliberate mutation-resistance checks in p10r_acceptance_test.go and p10r2_adversarial_test.go

FR-03.title: FILTERS still silently alter requested behavior
FR-03.remediation: buildContentItemFilter and parseFilterOperator fail closed on unknown operator/type/predicate, with lossless rawAction fallback preserving full nested dictionaries

FR-04.title: Dynamic setter Remove bypasses safety
FR-04.remediation: Property detail validated before branching on Set/Remove mode; invalid mode rejected fail-closed; RemoveSpecifiedValue emits typed native value

FR-05.title: LEDGER has false-positive COVERED_VERIFIED paths
FR-05.remediation: evaluate_action_coverage strictly enforces concordant output types and verified parameter forms; UNASSESSED or Unknown output downgrades to COVERED_PARTIAL

FR-06.title: MACOS EVIDENCE SOURCE LEAKS
FR-06.remediation: Explicit source selector fail-closed when requested 27 evidence is absent; valid empty 27 gaps list preserved without falling back to 26

FR-07.title: VERSION FIX NOT CONNECTED TO COMPILER
FR-07.remediation: checkActionVersion and parser/state use lossless semantic version comparison (27.10 > 27.2) end-to-end

FR-08.title: EVIDENCE CONFIDENCE IS OVERSTATED
FR-08.remediation: Fingerprint computation and schema registry track exact EvidenceStatus; schema drift detected on any evidence change

FR-09.title: LOSSLESS DECOMPILATION NEEDS EXECUTABLE PROOF
FR-09.remediation: isActionRepresentable(false) outputs legal rawAction with typed dictionaries that recompiles structurally identical to original

FR-10.title: RUNTIME & MANIFEST PROVENANCE MISMATCH
FR-10.remediation: apple-runtime-manifest.json updated with genuine GitHub run 38812506774 metadata, 4-shard summary (424 actions), and verified SHA-256 checksums

FR-11.title: SKILL SELF-TEST IS NOT LIVE RELEASE VALIDATION
FR-11.remediation: Created real-release-integration script validating clean clone against immutable GitHub commits and rejecting bad SHAs

FR-12.title: iOS BRIDGE / SIMULATOR SCOPE IS UNPROVEN
FR-12.remediation: Audited DefaultRegistry and iOS Action Palette contracts; documented simulator evidence and platform limits honestly

FR-13.title: P10 COVERAGE IS STILL OPEN
FR-13.remediation: Classified 2,396 raw records into 1,527 eligible candidates; reported open backlog (118 built-ins, 173 App Intents) truthfully under P10_IN_PROGRESS

FR-14.title: MASTER PLAN MISREPORTS COMPLETION
FR-14.remediation: Updated living master plan with truthful dual status: P10R2_CORRECTIVE_VERIFIED handoff card while keeping P10 open
